name: Democratic Party
description: Follow Democratic Party, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: They’re Battle-Tested Democrats. Do Voters Care?
changes.summary: Haley Stevens and Angie Craig were celebrated by Democrats in 2018. This year, they’ve faced tough primaries.

changes.title: What's at stake for Democrats in next week's Wisconsin primary
changes.summary: More states will hold primary elections next week, including Wisconsin, where democratic socialist Francesca Hong is leading several polls in her run for governor. CBS News' Zak Hudak takes a look at the race as the countdown to the midterm elections continues.

changes.title: Orange County residents say the American dream is slipping away
changes.summary: Republicans and Democrats, renters and homeowners, rich and poor—agree on at least one thing: Buying a home is harder today than it was for their parents. The latest UCI-OC Poll suggests that's just the beginning of the problem.

changes.title: Moderate Democrats Prepare for ‘War’ Against an Ascendant Left
changes.summary: One moderate group says the progressive wins are “deeply troubling” and is planning a $15 million effort against democratic socialism.

changes.title: After Michigan, Democrats' next battleground over the party's future shifts to Wisconsin
changes.summary: In a year where voters upset with the Democratic Party mainstream have propelled outsider candidates to victory across the country, this candidate is hoping to buck the trend in Wisconsin.

changes.title: New Jersey's Mikie Sherrill enters national political fray with first set of midterm endorsements, aimed at veterans
changes.summary: New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill is taking her first major step onto the national stage, endorsing 13 Democrats - as the moderate signals she may jump into the debate over her party's future.

changes.title: Thanedar becomes latest incumbent to fall to a progressive challenger
changes.summary: Michigan Rep. Shri Thanedar lost his primary to democratic socialist Donavan McKinney on Wednesday — the latest victory for progressives who’ve been on a hot streak of ousting incumbents in safe-blue districts. Thanedar’s 13th District was a top priority for groups like Justice Democrats that are committed to primaryin.

changes.title: House Democrats just added 12 'safe' Trump districts to their midterm election target list
changes.summary: The move brings the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee's list of targets to 58, an ambitious list that reflects President Donald Trump's diminished standing with the electorate and Democrats' belief that they can capitalize on voters' frustrations.

changes.title: Virginia Democrats pick establishment nominees for 2 House seats they hope to flip
changes.summary: In Virginia, Democratic primary voters have a history of rewarding moderate candidates, a trend that continued on Tuesday.

changes.title: Takeaways from Tuesday's elections in Michigan and more
changes.summary: Democrats need to rack up as many wins as possible to take back the U.S. Senate, so the party has little room for error.
